title: show ipv6 interfaces command result doesn't conclude neighbor ipv6 address
author: tim-rj
body:
[version]
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.67-8367dfeb
Distribution: Debian 9.12
Kernel: 4.9.0-11-2-amd64

Platform: x86_64-ruijie_b6510-48vs8cq-r0

[operation & rslt]

lo ::1/128 up/up N/A N/A

Error: No such command "ipv4".

2001:50:5:1::1 4 501 48 79 0 0 0 00:03:54 Active

[expection]
"show ipv6 interface" for Ethernet52's Neighbor IP should not be N/A, but 2001:50:5:1::1/64

[log]
[syslog.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/4734814/syslog.txt)

comments.author: tim-rj
comments.body: This line "fe80::5a69:6cff:fefb:2230%Ethernet52/64" should not be in show result which causes this issue.
